claims.statement: hyperdx.existingSecret.name, hyperdx.configSecretRefs, mongodb.existingPasswordSecret.name and clickhouse.existingUserPasswordSecret (name, appPasswordKey default CLICKHOUSE_APP_PASSWORD, otelCollectorPasswordKey default CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD) are fork values that default to empty.
When hyperdx.existingSecret.name is set the chart does not render its shared Secret and allows hyperdx.secrets to be null with MongoDB, ClickHouse or the collector enabled.
clickstack.hyperdx.secretName defaults to clickstack-secret and is used for envFrom in the HyperDX Deployment and the check-alerts CronJob.

Keys listed in hyperdx.configSecretRefs are omitted from clickstack-config and rendered as secretKeyRef env entries on HyperDX workloads, with key defaulting to the map key, optional defaulting to false and name required.
DEFAULT_CONNECTIONS and DEFAULT_SOURCES rendering is shared by the Deployment and CronJob through clickstack.hyperdx.defaultConfigEnv.
With mongodb.existingPasswordSecret.name set, the chart skips the MongoDB password bridge Secret and sets passwordSecretRef.name on the first mongodb.spec.users entry only.

With clickhouse.existingUserPasswordSecret.name set, the app and otelcollector user passwords become @from_env CLICKHOUSE_APP_PASSWORD and CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD, and matching secretKeyRef env entries are appended to containerTemplate.env; users absent from values are not recreated.
cluster.yaml fails rendering if containerTemplate.env already defines CLICKHOUSE_APP_PASSWORD or CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD for a managed user.

In existing shared Secret mode, rendering fails when MONGO_URI still uses hyperdx.secrets without configSecretRefs.MONGO_URI, when defaultConnections uses hyperdx.secrets without useExistingConfigSecret, when MongoDB is enabled without existingPasswordSecret, or when ClickHouse is enabled without existingUserPasswordSecret.
Rendering fails when the existing Secret name is not clickstack-secret, the collector is enabled, and no otel-collector.extraEnvsFrom entry references that Secret name.

tests/external-secrets_test.yaml (suite Test External Secret Mode) asserts that chart Secrets are not rendered, MONGO_URI leaves the ConfigMap, workloads reference external Secrets, MongoDBCommunity uses the external password Secret and ClickHouse users use external passwords.
.changeset/managed-secret-refs.md targets package helm-charts while .changeset/clickhouse-secret-env-passwords.md targets @hyperdx/clickstack, a name that is not the workspace package (helm-charts).
The values.yaml comment above hyperdx.secrets still says null requires mongodb, clickhouse and otel-collector to all be disabled.

With hyperdx.tasks.enabled true and no fork values set, the check-alerts CronJob renders DEFAULT_CONNECTIONS and DEFAULT_SOURCES from the chart defaults through clickstack.hyperdx.defaultConfigEnv, whereas upstream f114951's CronJob rendered neither.
The .Values.hyperdx.secrets render checks inspect only hyperdx.config.MONGO_URI and hyperdx.deployment.defaultConnections.
In external mode cluster.yaml rewrites only the app and otelcollector ClickHouse users; other users, including any literal passwords, are rendered into the ClickHouseCluster CR as supplied.
